lcv_peer_set.formula: LCV share = (V19 CY2025 LCV units × €250 ISZE-net rate) ÷ (that LCV wallet + LD/MD/F-Series × v9 base rates). Peer = share ≥ 90%. IBX is BELGIUM / sold-to 90 — included when it qualifies. Complete-CY billed euros (credits out) stamp book size; sales lines have no vehicle segment so SKU-level LCV billed cannot be split. Turkey and MIDI are not ISZE distributors and are not in the set. UMI 1797 is never blended with UTI 1799.
